{{< include macros.qmd >}}

This page demonstrates the include-shortcode strategy for loading macros. 
The YAML front matter of this file includes:

```yaml
format:
  html: default
  pdf: default
  revealjs:
    output-file: demo-shortcode-slides.html
  docx: default
```

## Example math

The table below uses macros defined with `\def` in `macros.qmd`, which work in all output formats that support MathJax or LaTeX:

| Description | Code | Output |
|---|---|---|
| Greek: alpha | `$\a$` | $\a$ |
| Greek: beta | `$\b$` | $\b$ |
| Greek: gamma | `$\g$` | $\g$ |
| Greek: lambda | `$\l$` | $\l$ |
| Greek: sigma | `$\s$` | $\s$ |
| Log-likelihood | `$\llik$` | $\llik$ |
| Independent | `$X \ind Y$` | $X \ind Y$ |
| IID distributed | `$X_i \siid \Normal(\m, \ss)$` | $X_i \siid \Normal(\m, \ss)$ |
| Vector: mu | `$\vm$` | $\vm$ |
| Hat beta | `$\hb$` | $\hb$ |
